States can establish their own Human Rights Commissions to address violations at the state level.

items: State Human Rights Commissions focus specifically on violations occurring within state jurisdiction.
The power to establish human rights commissions at the regional level lies with the respective states.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Individual states have the authority to set up their own Human Rights Commissions.
The primary mandate of these bodies is to address human rights violations at the state level.
